einzeiler: Author Penn Cole discusses the final book in The Kindred's Curse Saga and series lore.
kurzfassung: Host Jess chats with author Penn Cole about the final book in The Kindred's Curse Saga, Burn of the Everflame. They dive deep into the series' intricate world-building, character motivations, and fan-favorite dynamics. Cole shares insights into her writing journey and the emotional themes of the final installment.
stichpunkte: Penn Cole discusses the upcoming release of Burn of the Everflame and the conclusion of her series.
The conversation explores the deep connection between characters, magic, and culture in the realms of Amarion.
Cole defends Henry's character arc and explains his core motivations within the rebellion.
The hosts analyze Diem's relatable growth, leadership style, and her complex relationship with Orly.
Luther's role as a shadow daddy and his internal struggles with self-worth and obligation are dissected.
Scars as both visible and invisible markers of trauma and healing are examined across multiple characters.
Cole reveals that hope is the central theme and emotional takeaway she wants readers to find in the final book.

clips.hook: Over five years in the making
clips.text: The author reflects on the surreal feeling of finally releasing a story that has existed in her head since 2020.
Moving from Texas to Europe heavily influenced how the author designed distinct realms that sit close together while maintaining unique cultures.
The author analyzes a controversial character's tendency to be heavily influenced by whoever is leading or yelling the loudest around him.

beschreibung:
Hey there, how are ya?! In this episode, Jess is joined by Penn Cole, author of the Kindred’s Curse Saga! The final book in the series, Burn of the Everflame, releases this September, and this episode contains SPOILERS for all released books in the series but is spoiler free for Burn. During this chat, Jess and Penn dive deep into a handful of the amazing characters in this series, like Henri, Diem, and Luther (of course). Penn also gives us one word to describe the main takeaway she wants readers to have after reading Burn! This conversation is literally a dream come true for Jess, so grab yourself a cup of something wonderful and come on in!
